# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Empty-seed iteration on the TOOLS capability (tau2 airline). Reward = db_reward × communicate_reward
(ACTION checks are informational only — reward_basis = [DB, COMMUNICATE]). So the lever is
matching the final DB state, and the biggest DB-blocker is write calls that hard-fail in the env.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Malformed write arguments hard-fail the env before any DB write | 8, 25, 23, 22 | `date_of_birth` not `dob`; payment items `{type,id}`/`{id}` not `{payment_id,amount}`; `insurance:"none"` not `"no"` — pydantic rejects → 0 writes | KNOWLEDGE + CAPABILITY-GAP | in-body normalization guards |
| 2 | Payment amounts don't sum to total_price (env requires exact sum) | 25, 8, 23 | weak model miscomputes/splits the total (25: paid 299 vs 375; 8: 500 vs 348); env even reports true total but model can't split it | CAPABILITY-GAP | composite auto-redistribution (real code) |
| 3 | Wrong reservation_id chosen (UM3OG5 vs gold FQ8APE) | 17, 22 | comprehension error picking among the user's reservations | BEHAVIORAL | SKIPPED (no bounded guard; would need gold id) |
| 4 | Transfer-to-human instead of the allowed action | 19 | agent transferred (basic-econ can't be *modified*) when gold was *cancel* | DECISION | SKIPPED (loosening = regression risk) |
| 5 | Extra unrequested write / narrated-then-stopped | 12, 40 | 12 adds a business-cabin upgrade not in gold; 40 user emits ###STOP### right after "yes" | BEHAVIORAL/INFRA | SKIPPED |
| — | infra noise | 37 | user-simulator leaked-reasoning ###STOP### (documented) | — | SKIPPED per instructions |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body normalization | book_reservation.py | Normalize passenger dob (from date_of_birth/etc.), payment `payment_id` (from `id`), missing `amount`→0, insurance synonyms→'yes'/'no'. General key/value canonicalization, no task literals. | YES — only rewrites malformed keys; correct dicts pass byte-identical. Verified passthrough. |
| 2 | composite atomic-write (real loop + env calls) | book_reservation.py | On the env's "total price is X…add up" error ONLY, fetch balances via env_get_user_details and redistribute: fill gift-card/certificate up to balance, remainder on credit card; retry once. Reproduces tau2's gold split convention generally. | YES — retry fires only when the first real call already FAILED on the amount mismatch; passing bookings return a dict on call #1, no retry, no extra env call. Verified. |
| 1 | in-body normalization + doc | update_reservation_passengers.py | Same dob normalization; docstring states count-must-match + read-current-first + exact key shape. | YES — bounded to missing-dob dicts; correct dob passes through. Verified. |

## Verify-the-fix
- T25 args (date_of_birth + {type,id} + amounts 128/171 + insurance "none"): normalization fixes shapes; first env call fails "total price is 375"; redistribute→gift 128 + credit 247 (== gold); retry succeeds. Passthrough test with correct {payment_id,amount,dob,insurance:"no"} → 1 env call, no retry, args unchanged.
- T8 args (single certificate, amount 500 vs total 348): redistribute charges min(bal 500, 348)=348 (== gold). Success.
- T23 res1 (4 methods, no amounts, total 871): redistribute → cert 500 / gift 198 / gift 129 / credit 44 (== gold), and identical result even when agent lists credit-card first (order-robust).
- update_reservation_passengers: {date_of_birth} → adds dob; correct {dob} passes through unchanged.
- Structural: all 14 script files have exactly one top-level def named after the file; ast-verified.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Diagnosed via a Python extractor over trajectories comparing gold action_checks vs actual tool_calls + env error responses; read real tau2 airline tools.py/data_model.py to confirm the env validation order and that reward_basis excludes ACTION.
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; RUNMAP/LEDGER/rejected all empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The bounded-retry safety pattern: only recompute payments when the FIRST real call fails with the amount-mismatch error, so passing bookings are never altered. Keep the "if sum already correct → pass through" property.
- The greedy split convention (limited-balance methods first, remainder on credit) matches tau2 gold — do not change to even-split.
- Do NOT normalize by removing extra flight keys — pydantic already ignores them; stripping is needless risk.

## Deliberately skipped
- 17/22 wrong reservation_id, 19 transfer-vs-cancel, 12 extra business upgrade, 40 early ###STOP###: comprehension/decision/infra failures with no bounded, generalizing tool guard — a fix would either hardcode a gold value or loosen a global decision rule (regression risk). Left for a prompt-owning capability, not tools.
- 37: infra noise per instructions.
- Broad error-enrichment on "not found" (hallucinated ids): marginal (agent invented values it can't recover from a list) and return-enrichment is re-read every turn — skipped to avoid noise.
